plotEn:
Aasha is a widowed, middle-aged woman who runs a plant nursery and lives with her younger daughter, Anagha, while her elder daughter resides in Dubai. Hardened by a history of domestic abuse from her late husband, Aasha exhibits a volatile and unyielding temperament. Although her widower neighbor, Santhosh, harbors feelings for her, she postpones any thoughts of companionship until her Anagha is settled. Aasha strongly disapproves of Anagha's unemployed boyfriend, Sreejith, and actively arranges for prospective grooms to visit their home.
One night, while driving home from a movie, Aasha swerves abruptly to avoid a pothole. Consequently, a pickup truck trailing behind them—driven by a plumbing worker named Jeemon alongside his colleague, Asif veers off the road and crashes into a tree to avoid a collision. Enraged by the vehicular damage and Asif's minor head injury, Jeemon confronts Aasha and confiscates her car keys. Refusing to acknowledge her fault, Aasha escalates the altercation. When locals intervene and notice that Jeemon has been drinking, Aasha fabricates a narrative, accusing the men of drunkenly stalking and harassing them.
Despite the police and Anagha's advising a compromise, Aasha files a formal complaint, resulting in the police physically abusing and humiliating Jeemon.
